content.short: Cardano Media Taiwan provides the latest info & free education about Cardano in Mandarin.
content.description: Cardano Media Taiwan is built by the Cardano NFT project, Night Parade of 100 Demons. The core team members are all Taiwanese. We are dedicated to the general Cardano education in Mandarin. We have a Facebook group with 3.3K members, a Telegram group with 280 members, an official account and a Youtube Channel. Every day, we translate important tweets into Mandarin for followers. Every week, we release Youtube videos for people to keep track of latest info and learn the infrastructure of Cardano.
content.meta: Find out about Cardano Media Taiwan (COMMUNITY) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
